mapper.sql: AND ( (t.status=1 AND t.expire_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM groupbuy_member pm JOIN `order` po ON po.id=pm.order_id LEFT JOIN refund pr ON pr.order_id=po.id WHERE pm.team_id=t.id AND (pr.status IN (3,4) OR (t.status=2 AND po.pay_status=1 AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM coupon pc WHERE pc.order_id=po.id )) OR (t.status=3 AND po.inventory_released=FALSE)) ) )
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.created_at >= #{since} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS total_teams, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.created_at >= #{since} AND t.status=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS active_teams, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.created_at >= #{since} AND t.status=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS formed_teams, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.created_at >= #{since} AND t.status=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS expired_teams, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status=1 AND t.expire_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS overdue_active_teams, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.created_at >= #{since} THEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM groupbuy_member sm WHERE sm.team_id=t.id ) ELSE 0 END),0) AS member_orders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.created_at >= #{since} THEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM groupbuy_member spm JOIN `order` spo ON spo.id=spm.order_id WHERE spm.team_id=t.id AND spo.pay_status IN (1,2,3) ) ELSE 0 END),0) AS paid_orders, COALESCE(SUM(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM groupbuy_member srm JOIN refund sr ON sr.order_id=srm.order_id WHERE srm.team_id=t.id AND sr.refund_type='groupbuy_expired' AND sr.status=3 )),0) AS pending_refunds, COALESCE(SUM(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM groupbuy_member sfm JOIN refund sfr ON sfr.order_id=sfm.order_id WHERE sfm.team_id=t.id AND sfr.refund_type='groupbuy_expired' AND sfr.status=4 )),0) AS failed_refunds, COALESCE(SUM(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM groupbuy_member scm JOIN `order` sco ON sco.id=scm.order_id WHERE scm.team_id=t.id AND t.status=2 AND sco.pay_status=1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM coupon sc WHERE sc.order_id=sco.id) )),0) AS missing_coupon_orders, COALESCE(SUM(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM groupbuy_member sim JOIN `order` sio ON sio.id=sim.order_id WHERE sim.team_id=t.id AND t.status=3 AND sio.inventory_released=FALSE )),0) AS unreleased_inventory_orders FROM groupbuy_team t JOIN groupbuy_campaign c ON c.id=t.campaign_id JOIN shop s ON s.id=c.shop_id WHERE t.region=#{region} AND c.region=#{region} AND s.region=#{region}
mapper.sql: t.id,t.campaign_id,c.title AS campaign_title,c.shop_id,s.name AS shop_name,s.city_id, t.region,t.status,t.member_count,t.paid_count,c.group_size,t.expire_at,t.created_at,t.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM groupbuy_member lm WHERE lm.team_id=t.id) AS member_orders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM groupbuy_member lpm JOIN `order` lpo ON lpo.id=lpm.order_id WHERE lpm.team_id=t.id AND lpo.pay_status IN (1,2,3)) AS paid_orders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM groupbuy_member lrm JOIN refund lr ON lr.order_id=lrm.order_id WHERE lrm.team_id=t.id AND lr.refund_type='groupbuy_expired' AND lr.status=3) AS pending_refunds, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM groupbuy_member lfm JOIN refund lfr ON lfr.order_id=lfm.order_id WHERE lfm.team_id=t.id AND lfr.refund_type='groupbuy_expired' AND lfr.status=4) AS failed_refunds, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM groupbuy_member lcm JOIN `order` lco ON lco.id=lcm.order_id WHERE lcm.team_id=t.id AND t.status=2 AND lco.pay_status=1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM coupon lc WHERE lc.order_id=lco.id)) AS missing_coupon_orders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM groupbuy_member lim JOIN `order` lio ON lio.id=lim.order_id WHERE lim.team_id=t.id AND t.status=3 AND lio.inventory_released=FALSE) AS unreleased_inventory_orders
mapper.select: SELECT FROM groupbuy_team t JOIN groupbuy_campaign c ON c.id=t.campaign_id JOIN shop s ON s.id=c.shop_id WHERE t.id=#{teamId} AND t.region=#{region} AND c.region=#{region} AND s.region=#{region}
